title: Friction points & decisions log — PM/Eng 1:1 (API, Console, Dedicated, Private)
content:
Context:
- Quick sync with Eng Lead (Rhea) to align on next two sprints: prioritization across Hosted API features, Console rollout polish, Dedicated capacity routing, and Private deployment onboarding.
- Goal for this 1:1: leave with firm owners, deadlines for the top 6 tradeoff decisions, and a confidence level that we can hit the demo for Sales on 2026-04-01.

Agenda (30–40m):
1) Quick status (5m) — velocity, recent outages, blocking PRs.
2) API surface decisions (10m) — streaming vs chunked fallback behavior, token accounting change, client backward compat.
3) Console UX for rollout control (8m) — rollout UI state, canary window defaults, audit log export format.
4) Dedicated & Private capacity (10m) — routing/fallback policy when dedicated pool saturated, KMS/HSM onboarding checklist for private customers.
5) Action alignment & owners (5m) — assign tasks, set dates.

Prep notes / quick bullets to bring up:
- API: recent customer says streaming drop leads to partial tokens billed; engineering noted potential for re-emit at boundary causing doubled tokens. Ask: do we accept small overbilling for reliability (temporary), or hold and fix protocol to avoid doubles?
- Console: product team prefers default canary 10% / 24h; engineering favors shorter canary but more aggressive metrics. Need to pick default that reduces support but doesn't block customers.
- Dedicated: autoscale QPS thresholds are opaque in current UI; SRE signaled we need a traffic shaping policy doc before next onboarding.
- Private: checklist for KMS integration currently lacks HSM proof-of-concept steps; Legal requested attestation template.

Decisions needed (explicit ask):
- D1 (API billing behavioral fix): temporary mitigation (emit warning + credits) vs immediate protocol change. Need decision by 2026-03-16. Owner: Devon + Rhea.
- D2 (Default canary policy): choose between "conservative" (10%/24h) or "fast" (20%/6h) defaults for Console. Need decision by 2026-03-18. Owner: Product (Devon) + Eng (Marta).
- D3 (Dedicated fallback routing): define hard-fallback order: region -> degraded-quantized-variant -> hosted. Need architecture doc update by 2026-03-20. Owner: Rhea.
- D4 (Private KMS/HSM onboarding): agree on attestation checklist + PoC owner. Decision by 2026-03-22. Owner: Security (Marta) + Solutions Eng.

Success criteria for upcoming demo (2026-04-01):
- No streaming token-billing regressions on test suite (ci/stress/streaming).
- Console ability to start a canary and see per-tenant metrics within 5m.
- Dedicated route fallback exercised end-to-end in staging with synthetic load.
- Private onboarding doc + attestation template present for first sales meeting.

Risks / unknowns:
- Customer billing semantics: need legal sign-off on credit policy if we do temporary overbilling remediation.
- Metric latency: Console metrics pipeline has occasional 30–90s lag; canary defaults assume <30s. If we pick faster canary we risk false positives.
- Dedicated capacity: hardware availability projected but not guaranteed for late-April installs; fallback must be tightly tested.

Concrete action items (owner — due):
- A1: Draft temporary customer communication + credit policy for streaming token edge case (Devon, Legal review) — due 2026-03-15.
- A2: Run targeted streaming token-billing test matrix and capture failure modes (Marta + QA) — due 2026-03-14.
- A3: Prototype console canary UI change that exposes "canary window" as a modifiable field (Eng Frontend) — Rhea will assign — due 2026-03-19.
- A4: Write Dedicated fallback architecture sketch and runbook for staging validation (Rhea) — due 2026-03-20.
- A5: Compile Private KMS/HSM attestation template + list of PoC items for Security (Marta) — due 2026-03-22.

Talking points to surface in the meeting:
- Tradeoff framing: faster canaries reduce time-to-detect but increase noisy rollouts — propose metric guardrails (error% & latency delta thresholds).
- Economics: quantify token-cost impact if we accept temporary double-emits vs engineering time to fix protocol. Bring rough $/1M token estimate for decision.
- Customer empathy: show one support thread and the affected customer's SLA to underline urgency.

Parking lot / follow-ups not for this 1:1:
- Longer discussion on model variant auto-qualification for Dedicated pools (schedule with ModelOps).
- Audit log retention tiers + pricing (ops + finance sync).

Notes for post-meeting update (what I will write in the follow-up):
- Summary of decisions (D1–D4) with owners & deadlines.
- Short FAQ for CS about the streaming billing mitigation.
- Rollout checklist update link and changes for canary defaults.

Quick personal checklist before the call (Devon):
- Bring the customer support thread and the sample billing trace.
- Prepare a 2-slide internal snapshot (one slide: options/costs; one slide: risks & mitigation).
- Confirm Legal can do quick review on credit policy by 2026-03-15.

End of scratchpad.

Revision history:
- 2026-03-09: initial draft for prep.
- 2026-03-11: added Dedicated fallback ACTION and updated owners after sync with Marta.
- 2026-03-12: clarified deadlines and added linked artifacts.
